args.text:
Golden Crust has been baking in the same stone oven on Mill Lane since 1987. We mill our own rye, feed a sourdough starter older than the shop, and shape every loaf by hand.
Come early: the first batch leaves the oven at six.

12 Mill Lane
Riverton RT1 4BB
01234 567890
Open daily 7am – 3pm

args.alt_text: A fresh sourdough loaf on a wooden board

args.text:
It started with one oven and a borrowed recipe for country sourdough. Neighbours queued around the corner, so we kept baking.
Today the bakery is still family run. We use flour from farms within forty miles, long slow fermentation for flavour and keeping quality, and nothing you cannot pronounce.
Every morning we bake sourdough, rye, seeded and spelt loaves, buttery croissants and cinnamon buns. On Fridays and Saturdays we add gluten-free and vegan bakes.
Celebration cakes are made to order: tell us the occasion three days ahead and we will design something special. We also supply cafés and restaurants across the valley, delivering before eight so their bread is as fresh as ours.
Baking classes run on the first Sunday of every month: mix, shape and bake your own loaf, and take home a jar of our starter.
